fields.v: Partly (0.5): the authors created PackHallu (and the Repeat Attack baseline; Combined Attack [11] and ObliInjection [13] share co-authors Gong and R. Wang), but it is compared with external baselines (GCG [12], TAP [14]) and run against coding agents the authors did not make (OpenHands, Claude Code, Cursor, etc.)
fields.quote: Compared attacks: We compare PackHallu with five representative prompt injection attack baselines, comprising two heuristic-based attacks and three optimization-based attacks.
fields.where: §6.1 Experimental Setup, Compared attacks, p. 8 (baselines described p. 9; references [11]-[14], p. 20)
fields.why: By the protocol rule, the authors' own approach compared with external ones scores Partly, not No.
fields.doubt: Os autores criaram o PackHallu, mas comparam-no com ataques de outros (GCG de Zou et al., TAP de Mehrotra et al.) e atacam agentes que não são deles. A regra diz Parcial quando a abordagem própria é comparada com externas. Vê pág. 8-9 e referências [11]-[14] na pág. 20 e decide Q12.

fields.v: Proposes an approach; secondary: Compares — package hallucination attack and PackHallu, an evolutionary optimizer of malicious prompts injected into rule files; attack success compared with 5 prompt-injection baselines and measured across 3 benchmarks, 8 agent frameworks, 13 LLMs; 5 detectors evaluated
fields.quote: We propose PackHallu, an evolutionary search framework for optimizing malicious prompts embedded within coding rule files to induce package hallucination attacks.
fields.why: The paper's central contribution is a proposed method (PackHallu) that it then evaluates and compares, and the record's own Q12 treats PackHallu as 'the approach evaluated', which fits 'Proposes an approach' better than 'Evaluates'.
fields.doubt: O contributo principal é propor o PackHallu (um método de ataque) e depois avaliá-lo contra 5 ataques de base. Isso encaixa em 'Proposes an approach; secondary: Compares'. Se mudares, Q13 passa a aplicar-se. Decide se um método de ataque conta como 'abordagem' no sentido do protocolo (pág. 2-3).

fields.v: Partly (0.5): requirements stated (locally hosted surrogate agent and attack LLM via Ollama on up to two NVIDIA Quadro RTX 6000 GPUs, 24 GB each; about 24-30 h per optimization run; one prompt reused across package pairs); within reach of a well-equipped team, but it is an attack, not a development practice
fields.quote: Each model is deployed on up to two NVIDIA Quadro RTX 6000 GPUs (24 GB each), depending on its size. Under this setup, a full optimization run takes approximately 24 to 30 hours
fields.why: Q13 is N/A only while the nature is 'Evaluates'; if the study is classed as proposing an approach (PackHallu), Q13 applies and the paper states its compute requirements.
fields.doubt: Só faz sentido se mudares a natureza para 'Proposes an approach'. Nesse caso Q13 aplica-se: o artigo indica 2 GPUs RTX 6000 e 24-30 horas por otimização (pág. 23). Decide se fica N/A ou Parcial, conforme a decisão sobre a natureza.
